why: In the first pair, the second figure is the mirror image of the first (the arms of the cross hook the opposite way). So the arrow must also be turned into its mirror image. Options 1, 2, 3 and 5 are the same arrow only turned around (0, 180, 90 and 270 degrees), and a turned figure can never become a mirror image. Only option 4 is flipped, so it is the mirror image.
trick: If the first pair is a mirror image, ignore all options that are just rotations of the figure. Look for the one option that cannot be made by turning the figure.
note: Option 4 is hand-drawn approximately; the answer relies on 1,2,3,5 being rotations of the question arrow and 4 being the odd (flipped) one.
